live.stage.cpu.p50.note: the rebuilt realm's frame staged (LiveStagingTimeTests: 50 cities and 51 armies in a laptop's window), by the thread's own clock, brought to the calibration's pace. Runs 1111 to 1136 read 7.6 to 11.05 at the pace, and the baseline was 9.5, until the staging was told part by part (run 1136: the cities 8.40 ms of 12.26, the armies 3.10) and the holds' still pieces were kept staged and every pose kept once worked out (0c664da, 4e9497a): run 1138 read 4.57 ms, 3.71 at the pace. The baseline is 4.5, a regression still half as much again, and the test holds the median within a frame at the pace

live.stage.cpu.p95.note: the same frame's slowest twentieth, by the thread's own clock, brought to the calibration's pace: runs 1118 to 1126 read 14.4 to 18.1, and the baseline was 15; with the holds' pieces and the poses kept (run 1138) it read 6.41 ms, 5.2 at the pace, so 6, allowed more than the median
